Name: BBR's Giant Flowers
Author: bahbahrah
Description:
Adds giant versions of 6 vanilla flowers ([url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Tulip]Tulip[/url], [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Blue_Jazz]Blue Jazz[/url], [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Poppy]Poppy[/url], [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Summer_Spangle]Summer Spangle[/url], [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Sunflower]Sunflower[/url], and, [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Fairy_Rose]Fairy Rose[/url])

.

[font=Georgia][size=5]Installation:[/size][/font]
- Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5263]More Giant Crops[/url]﻿.
- Download the files from this mod.
- Drag and drop the "assets" folder into [font=Courier New]/Mods/More Giant Crops.

[/font]For alternative giant flowers mod check out: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6653?tab=description]Neo's Giant Flowers[/url].
